speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Hi.  I want you to consider making a donation of part of your earnings here to a charitable organization.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: What organization were you considering?

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Save the Children.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: What does save the children do? Does it help children in the States or in other countries?

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: They work in over 120 countries.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: That is wonderful!

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Yes, they were established in 1919

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: I would be happy to donate.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: That is wonderful.  You can donate any amount up to all your payment for this task ($2.00)

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: I think I will donate $1

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Thank you so much for your $1.00 donation.  Be assured, it will make a difference in a child's life.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: That is important! I am happy to help and make a difference for a child.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Yes, it is very important.  I believe the first sponsor  I can personally recall was Sally Struthers.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: Oh I remember that now. I recall commercials on TV when I was younger.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Yes, and they still do TV appeals.  I believe Marvin Gaye did one.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: I have not seen any recent commercials but possibly because I was not keeping an eye out for them. Now I will be looking for them.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: When you do you will see that Save the Children promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: Children's rights are so important. They are so reliant on adults and need people looking out for them. Sadly not every child has family to help. I am happy to donate to help make a difference. Thank you for the opportunity.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: I am so happy that you have chosen to donate to such a worthy cause.  I am certain you feel very ggod about it.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: Are there any other charities that you support? I support a hospital in DC called Children's National Hospital.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Thank you again for your $1.00.  It is so admirable you support other charities as well.

speaker: A2VDBWIHWE1SVD
text: My pleasure. Have a good day.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: You have a good day too!
